'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Greg Hatt LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hatt]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Return of Brett P. Hatt
* '''Username:''' bcffett
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
